result: Verified the Desktop recursive renderer implements canonical inspector LayoutNode composition without local eligibility or layout synthesis.
implementation: Inspector rendering preserves canonical primary layout, side, span, and ordered inspector contribution identifiers.
Every inspector contribution resolves through the trusted contribution registry.
Malformed side/span/primary/identifier data and unknown bindings render an explicit fail-closed gap rather than a local fallback.
negative_cases: empty or duplicate inspector contribution identifiers
unknown or mismatched trusted renderer binding
acceptance: Inspector LayoutNode renders recursively from canonical projection data.
Untrusted or malformed inspector content fails closed.
